name: Tomato
description: High-value commercial vegetable crop cultivated across open fields and polyhouses in India. Extremely susceptible to fungal blights, viral complexes transmitted by whiteflies/thrips, and calcium-deficiency blossom end rot.
climate: Warm-season crop sensitive to frost and waterlogging; performs best in warm, sunny weather with moderate relative humidity.

suitable_types: Clay loam rich in organic matter
soil.drainage_requirement: Excellent surface and internal drainage essential; highly sensitive to waterlogging (causes root asphyxiation & bacterial wilt within 24h).
soil.organic_matter_requirement: High (>0.75% OC); apply 25 tonnes/ha well-decomposed FYM or 5 tonnes vermicompost.

planting_seasons: Kharif (June - July sowing, July - August transplanting)
Summer (January - February sowing in assured irrigation)
seed_rate_per_ha: 100-150 g/ha for F1 hybrids; 400-500 g/ha for open-pollinated varieties.

growth_stages.description: Portray / raised bed seedling germination under 50% shade net.
critical_activities: Protection from whiteflies using 40-mesh insect net

growth_stages.description: Transplanting shock recovery, vigorous lateral shoot development, staking installation.
critical_activities: Staking with bamboo poles and twine

growth_stages.description: Cluster flower emergence, pollination, early fruit set.
critical_activities: Boron foliar spray (1g/litre) to prevent flower drop
Calcium nitrate soil application (prevents Blossom End Rot)

growth_stages.description: Green mature fruit expansion, breaker stage, color turning from orange to deep red.
critical_activities: Avoid moisture fluctuations to prevent fruit cracking

irrigation.frequency_days: Daily or alternate days via drip (3-4 litres/plant/day during peak fruiting)

nutrients.basal_application: FYM 25 t/ha + 50 kg N + 100 kg P2O5 + 50 kg K2O per ha at bed preparation.
top_dressing_schedule: 25 kg N + 25 kg K2O at 30 days after transplanting (DAT)
50 kg N + 25 kg K2O at flowering stage (50-55 DAT)
25 kg N + 20 kg K2O during active fruiting flushes
micronutrient_requirements: Calcium Nitrate @ 5 kg/acre drenching to prevent Blossom End Rot (BER)

harvesting.duration_days: 90-140 days (harvesting occurs in multiple pickings over 6-8 weeks)
maturity_indices: Breaker stage (slight pink color at blossom end) for long-distance transit
Pink to red ripe stage for local fresh markets and processing
harvesting.harvesting_method: Hand pick with pedicel attached during cool morning or evening hours.
harvesting.average_yield_per_ha: 50 - 75 tonnes/ha for hybrids with drip and staking
harvesting.post_harvest_care: Grade by size and color, pack in plastic crates with paper cushioning; store at 12-15°C with 85-90% RH.
